pages.title: Fracture Ward
pages.text: A trace of what the Destabilised Husk carries, prepared so the body is ready for it. Use it on yourself: held safe from Fracture for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made on the Antibody Bench.
